title: EE-03/EE-04 Tasks API DB-touching handler tests unconditionally skip — no integration test exists
summary: tests/unit/test_tasks_api.zig contains DB-touching handler tests (TC-EE-03-API-05 through TC-EE-03-API-11, TC-EE-04-07, TC-EE-04-08, and additional cases at lines 102, 108, 114, 120, 126, 360, 369, 378) that all unconditionally return error.SkipZigTest. The file comment states these are 'Implemented in the integration test suite' but no integration test file for task API handler paths (createTask, listTasks, getTask, claimTask, completeTask, failTask) exists anywhere in tests/integration/. The HTTP API surface for EE-03 and EE-04 task lifecycle is completely untested end-to-end.

root_cause.details: Same pattern as ISS-0036. The referenced integration test file was never created. Tests that require DB access were skipped in the unit suite with an expectation that integration tests would cover them, but no TEST-DESIGNER handoff was ever created for the integration layer of the tasks API.

prevention: The same prevention as ISS-0036 applies. Test skips must trigger an immediate coverage tracking entry.

When DB-touching tests are skipped in a unit file with a comment referencing a future integration file, that integration file must be created in the same handoff or a follow-up handoff must be created before closing the workflow.
